words.g: and + in + to come, go in

verses.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

verses.en: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
verses.zh: 「你告诉亚伦说：点灯的时候，七盏灯都要向灯台前面发光。」

verses.en: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 亚伦便这样行。他点灯台上的灯，使灯向前发光，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

verses.en: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.
verses.zh: 这灯台的做法是用金子锤出来的，连座带花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照耶和华所指示的样式。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering
rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.zh: 「你从以色列人中选出利未人来，洁净他们。

verses.en: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

verses.en: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

words.g: to + an offence , and its penalty

words.g: the + a Levite or descendant of Levi

verses.en: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

words.g: the + a Levite or descendant of Levi

verses.en: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

verses.en: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:
verses.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。

verses.en: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
verses.zh: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他们伯叔的儿子。

words.g: Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses
and + Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite

verses.en: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.zh: 她们嫁入约瑟儿子、玛拿西子孙的族中；她们的产业仍留在同宗支派中。

words.g: from + a family, i.e. circle of relatives
Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
a family, i.e. circle of relatives
father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their

verses.en: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押平原―约旦河边、耶利哥对面―藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。

words.g: the + a command, whether human or divine
Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
